name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
January 13, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Pastor Gary Stouffer, Church of Christ
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring January 14, 2009, "North Coastal Prevention Coalition Day" in the City of Vista, in recognition of their receiving the 2008 Coalition of Excellence Award by the Community Anti-Drug Coalition of America.
P2.
Make-A-Wish Foundation Presentation by Beth Duncan on Vista’s Big Give Drive February 9 - 13, 2009.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Special Event Banner Program for 2009 Calendar Year (CC)
C4.
Gift Limit Adjustment (CC)
C5.
Application for Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) License for Mariscos Las Palmas, 777 E. Vista Way (CC)
C6.
Escondido Avenue Street Name Change (CC)
C7.
Vista Village Drive Overcrossing Barrier Repair Project (CC)
C8.
S. Melrose Drive Traffic Signal Interconnect Change Order No. 1 (CC)
C9.
Moonlight Summer Season Ticket Prices (CC)
C10.
Lease Agreement with North County Lifeline (CC)
C11.
Lease Agreement with MAAC Project Headstart (CC)
C12.
Caltrans Transportation Planning Grant Award (CDC)
C13.
Supplemental Law Enforcement Services Fund (CC)
1.
Approve the expenditure plan for the FY 2008-2009 Supplemental Law Enforcement Services Fund Grant; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Operating Budget for FY 2008-2009.
C14.
Gang Resistance Education and Training Program Grant Application (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Sonic Drive-In Restaurant, D&M Investments Partners, Inc., Applicant (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Negative Declaration for the Specific Plan Amendment to Specific Plan No. 26, Special Use Permit inclusive of a Site Development Plan, and a Comprehensive Sign Program;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Special Use Permit inclusive of a Site Development Plan, and a Comprehensive Sign Program; and (Continued on following page)
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending the Specific Plan No. 26 (Downtown Vista) to Allow Drive-Thru Restaurants via a Special Use Permit within the CBD Zoned Areas, and with a Maximum of One Drive-Thru Restaurant in the Older/Historic Downtown Area."
PH2.
Zoning Code Amendment Regarding Home Occupation Requirements (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Negative Declaration for amendments to the Vista Development Code regarding home occupations;
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapters 18.02 and 18.58 of the Vista Development Code Relating to Home Occupations"; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , revising the fee for home occupation permits.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
